tools.name: get_runtime_summary
tools.description: Read a compact summary of the live Cruma runtime, including assigned domain, tunnel plan, transport count, listeners and processes.

tools.name: expose_local_port
tools.description: Make a local port PUBLICLY REACHABLE ON THE INTERNET through this agent's tunnel. Anyone with the returned URL can reach the local server, with no authentication added. Creates (or updates, if the name or port is already exposed) a backend for host:port (default 127.0.0.1) and a tunnel-only frontend at <name>.<assigned domain>, waits up to 30 s for the tunnel to have its public domain, and returns public_url, local_target and frontend_id. The share lasts until unexpose or until the agent stops.

tools.name: upsert_backend
tools.description: Add or replace one backend definition by id and rebuild proxy routing.

tools.name: upsert_frontend
tools.description: Add or replace one frontend definition by hostname and rebuild proxy routing.

tools.name: get_health_summary
tools.description: Return a fast, zero-argument health overview of the running Cruma agent: status ok, degraded or critical.
